subject: COVID-19 Distance Learning Plan Implementation
overview: The committee met to establish the district's formal response to the COVID-19 pandemic, specifically regarding the launch of a remote education model and the assessment of financial impacts. The board approved a pass-fail grading framework and canceled a major student field trip due to health concerns.

items.title: Superintendent's remarks
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent thanked staff for initial pandemic response efforts, including meal distribution and the sanitization of 400 Chromebooks for student use.

items.title: COVID-19 health update
items.summary: City health officials reported 53 confirmed cases in Medford and discussed the expansion of local testing at Lawrence Memorial Hospital and Wellington Circle.

items.title: Financial updates and review of wages
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Patterson presented a projected $1.9 million budget deficit resulting from revenue losses in tuition-based and rental-dependent revolving accounts.

items.title: Middle school New York City trip cancellation
items.summary: Approved the cancellation of the eighth-grade New York City trip, with administrators noting that all deposits from families would be fully refunded.

items.title: Distance learning plan
items.summary: Dr. Ricciardelli presented a formal remote learning framework effective April 1st that shifts grading to a pass-fail basis and focuses on reinforcing previously taught skills.

items.title: Proposed meeting schedule
items.summary: Approved a revised schedule for April 2020 that moves regular meetings to 4:00 PM to allow for more preparation time during the pandemic emergency.

items.title: Subcommittee meetings
items.summary: The Superintendent requested that subcommittee chairs coordinate with her office to space out future remote sessions.
